whatIs: 21st is a community catalog of more than 12,000 React and Tailwind components, plus complete templates, shadcn themes, shaders, and gradients. Each piece shows a live preview, the source code, and an install command, and the code is copied into your repository instead of being added as a dependency.
It's a good fit when you're looking for inspiration or a specific piece, such as a hero or a pricing section, and would rather adapt it to your project than use a closed library.
uses: Finding a hero or a pricing section and copying it into your project with the shadcn command.
Applying a shadcn theme to quickly change the palette of an existing interface.
Asking an AI tool to recreate a component in your code from its prompt.
caveats: Components are published by different authors, so check each one's page in case it has its own terms.
The free plan allows 2 component copies per day; to install without limits you need to subscribe.
Since it's copied code, fixes from the original author don't reach your project on their own.
pricingNote: Free plan with 2 component copies per day; the Builder plan costs $6 per month billed annually and removes that limit.
idealFor: React and Tailwind projects looking for ready-to-adapt components and themes.
